responsibility: Provides the PA-RISC SOM object-format support layer used mainly for HP-UX SOM targets. It enables SOM mode, defines how shared-library dependencies are parsed, emits SOM-style function descriptors and .EXPORT/.IMPORT directives with PA argument and return metadata, initializes SOM sections and file-start behavior, controls weak/comdat/one-only support under SOM linkers and GAS, and customizes constructor/destructor and alignment behavior required by SOM tools and runtime conventions.
